subject: design/implement-now-authenticated-review-obligations
statement: Configuration parsing distinguishes an absent `executor.review` block from a present block whose optional `backend` is empty. Absence returns `ReviewInstall{Enabled:false}` and performs no build, auth, catalog read, or model work. Presence creates a closed `ReviewInstall` with a positive independent width, attempt budget, and either one explicit backend or inherited backend selection.
